title: 2012 AMC 12A Problem 2
statement: Cagney can frost a cupcake every \(20\) seconds and Lacey can frost a cupcake every \(30\) seconds. Working together, how many cupcakes can they frost in \(5\) minutes?

solutions.text:
In \(5\) minutes there are \(300\) seconds. Cagney frosts \(\dfrac{300}{20} = 15\) cupcakes and Lacey frosts \(\dfrac{300}{30} = 10\) cupcakes.

Together they frost \(15 + 10 = 25\) cupcakes.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Convert \(5\) minutes to seconds, or count each person’s cupcakes per minute
